records.context: This module records manual counts on a :class:`spacr.layers.PointsLayer`, so each click is stored as data. records.context: The test does not combine per-guide P values. records.translation: 该检验不合并各向导序列的 P 值。Fisher 方法和 Stouffer 方法都假定被合并的 p 值相互独立，而在同一批孔中测得的两个向导序列并不独立：它们共享该孔的表型、该孔的板效应以及该孔的细胞。合并它们会报告一个设计无法支撑的置信度。

records.context: A one-degree-of-freedom set test cannot detect guides with opposite effects, which is why ``guides_in_gene`` is reported on every row: a gene whose guides push the phenotype in opposite directions cancels in the sum, exactly as it does in the parametric ``y ~ gene_fraction:gene`` fit that this mirrors. Such a gene is not evidence of no effect; it is evidence the guides disagree, and the guide-level table is where that shows. A gene resting on one guide (``guides_in_gene == 1``) is the same test as that guide's own row.

records.context: The ``+1`` in both places includes the observed configuration in its own reference set, which makes the test exact, giving ``P(p <= alpha) <= alpha`` under the null for any ``B``. records.context: Why this is not part of verbose logging: verbose logging only decides which log records are kept, so it records no memory figures. This module samples instead: one psutil read a second, on a daemon independent execution path that is never the main GUI execution path, on an otherwise unmodified run. It selects high-confidence anchor cells, propagates their labels over a k-nearest-neighbour graph, and projects the result onto the per-well guide fractions reported by sequencing.
records.translation: 混合筛选提供的是每个孔的向导序列计数，而不是每个细胞的向导序列身份。本模块将这些计数约束与测量空间中的相似性结合起来。它选择高置信度的锚定细胞，在 k 近邻图上传播其标签，并将结果投影到测序所报告的每孔向导序列比例上。
